text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Owww... Now I've really gone and done it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-but... if this is all it takes t'bring me down,
then what was the point in even com'n to the
city?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I don't make my inj'ry any worse,
so please lemme train!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But what if I fall way b'hind while I'm rest'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've already got a whole heap of catch'n up to
do...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...'Kay. But I'm gonna hold you to it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. What am I even doing here? I'm not
dazzl'n in the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin trudges back to the dorm looking
pained.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Time t'pep up and get back on track!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... ...Gotta endure!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Agh! Ow!
choice_data_list: Looks like it's more serious than we thought. Let's stop here. | Nombre=Yukino Bijin | Linea=Agh! Ow! | Anterior=Huff... Huff... ...Gotta endure! | Siguiente=B-but! I...]

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-but! I...
choice_data_list:
I promise I'll help you make up for the lost time.
| Nombre=Yukino Bijin | Linea=B-but! I... |
Anterior=Agh! Ow! | Siguiente=...Okay, fine. I
don't wanna worry you, after all...]

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, fine. I don't wanna worry you, after
all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being such a good-for-noth'n... Well,
I'm off t'get some rest...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A deeply frustrated Yukino Bijin takes my words to
heart and heads back to recuperate...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I have t'get closer—anything to make this gap smaller...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is about the best I can manage right now...
But still...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I've gotta do what I can t'make sure I can
catch up real quick once I recover!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin focuses on what she can do in the
moment, and it gives us good results!
